items.description: Kitchen: fire damage to units and worktop
items.evidence: Fire and Rescue Service report dated 2026-01-18 records a kitchen fire attended at the property, cause recorded as an unattended pan. Check-in inventory dated 2025-03-01 records the kitchen units and worktop as new. Check-out photographs show four base units and the full run of worktop charred through. A fitter's invoice dated 2026-02-10 for replacement of the affected units and worktop is included. The tenant does not dispute that the fire occurred during the tenancy.

items.description: Living room floor: water damage through to subfloor
items.evidence: Check-out inspection records the engineered floor lifted and cupped across approximately six square metres, with the subfloor beneath recorded as wet. A plumber's report dated 2026-02-02 attributes the water to a disconnected washing machine hose in the adjoining utility area. Photographs from check-in show the floor flat and unmarked. A flooring contractor's quotation for lifting, drying and relaying is included.

Check-in inventory lists a heated towel rail, a mirrored cabinet and a shower screen, each photographed. Check-out photographs show bare pipework, unfilled wall fixings where the cabinet was mounted, and no screen. The tenant's forwarding correspondence dated 2026-02-20 states the items were 'taken as they were replaced at my own cost', and no replacement receipts or landlord consent are in the bundle.

Check-out photographs show approximately three cubic metres of construction waste, including plasterboard and broken tiling, stacked against the rear boundary. The check-in inventory records the garden as clear and laid to lawn, with photographs. A licensed waste carrier's invoice dated 2026-02-14 for collection and disposal is included, with a waste transfer note.

items.description: Whole property: redecoration after unauthorized painting
items.evidence: Check-in inventory records all walls in a neutral emulsion, photographed room by room. Check-out photographs record every room repainted in dark, high-contrast colours. The tenancy agreement clause 12 prohibits redecoration without the landlord's prior written consent, and no consent is in the bundle. A decorator's quotation for stain-blocking primer and two coats throughout is included.
